Subject: Candidate: Sofia Morales — slate fair-share rebalance & proxy matching

Team,

Quick summary: Sofia Morales (SWE II candidate) just confirmed availability windows next week that leave a gap in our panel: she can only do late mornings PST on Tue/Wed and early afternoons on Thu. The current slate (attached) assigns two heavy-load interviewers at the same times, which pushes others over quota and risks late cancellations.

Ask: can we rebalance the slate so that no interviewer takes more than two 45‑minute blocks for Sofia's loop AND identify a proxy/shadow who can step in at 4 hours notice if someone needs to swap?

I attached slot_matrix.csv (current assignments + availability). My immediate suggestions:
- Move System Design from Markus (3x blocks already this week) to Priya (has capacity Tue 11:15–12:30).
- Shift Behavioral from Monica from Tue 10:00 to Thu 13:30 to smooth load.
- Identify one on-call proxy (shadow) who is comfortable doing a short post-interview calibration call.

Elena — copied you so Talent can share the candidate's exact timezone constraints; I’ll update the sheet if anything changes.

If you can reply with your confirmations + any swap counter-proposals by EOD today I’ll lock the schedule tomorrow AM and send candidate invite.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Recruiting Ops (Hiring coordinator)
Redwood Inference
